summary: Raytech Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a registered direct offering on June 29, 2026, under a shelf registration statement. The company sold 3,149,832 ordinary shares at $1.97 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of ~$6.2 million. CBC Securities Inc. acted as exclusive placement agent on a reasonable best-efforts basis, receiving a $50,000 fee. Participation by affiliated investors (Fortune Genesis Holdings and WK Frater Holdings) was approved by the board and audit committee under related-party procedures, with a lock-up through September 20, 2026. Net proceeds will fund general corporate purposes, expansion into personal health care electronics, and integration costs for the acquisition of Worry free Group. This is a capital-raising event rather than a special situation, as it is an ordinary shelf takedown. Watch for post-offering share price dilution and the company's execution on its strategic expansion.
